action: No action needed; for awareness. Operators of UAE energy, water and healthcare systems should treat hacktivist and proxy-group targeting as ongoing.
date_note: Date of the official's remarks as published by Khaleej Times; the attacks he describes ran from February 28 to early April.
exec: A UAE government cyber chief says dozens of groups tried to exploit a regional crisis to hit critical infrastructure; the claim is unverified by technical detail.
plain: A senior UAE cyber official says more than 40 hacking groups from over 20 countries tried to attack the country's energy, water and other key systems during the recent regional crisis.
summary: Mohammed Al Kuwaiti, Head of Cyber Security for the UAE Government, told a media forum that more than 40 groups from over 20 countries tried to exploit the regional crisis to attack the UAE, including energy and desalination systems. Attacks peaked from February 28 to early April. Geo News reports he repeated the figures in Dubai on 19 November, naming Iran-linked networks. No technical details were given.
title: UAE cyber chief: over 40 groups from 20+ countries targeted UAE infrastructure during regional crisis

validation.note: Khaleej Times (18 Nov, media forum remarks) and Geo News (19 Nov, World Police Summit remarks) both read in full; same official, separate publishers. No UAE government release was read.

review.note: Khaleej Times Nov 18: Al Kuwaiti, 40+ groups, 20+ countries, Feb 28-early April, Barakah match.
